description: Agent Claims: submit a repair or replacement estimate with the approved claim scope and the policy: the estimate with its reference, the claim number it cites, who prepared it, the currency, each line with its id, item, quantity, unit price and amount, the total, the deductible it takes off, the net amount and whether it states that its amount is over the applicable limit; the approved scope with its claim number and each item or repair approved; the policy with its number, the currency, the limit that applies to the loss and the deductible as an amount or as a percent of that limit. The signed report gives the estimate, the scope and the policy, each line read against the approved scope with every line outside it and every approved item left unpriced, each line, the total and the net recomputed, the deductible applied against the policy’s, and the amount payable against the applicable limit with any amount over it, and counts them, and names a divergent estimate: a line item outside the approved scope, a total that does not recompute, a deductible applied unlike the policy and an amount over the applicable limit that the estimate does not state; then another currency, an approved item left unpriced and another claim number, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No approved scope, no estimate lines, no policy deductible or no applicable limit leaves those points unverified. Lines read against the scope by their words with plurals folded, several lines may price one approved item, and the arithmetic compares to the cent. This reads the estimate against the scope and the policy terms as stated. Verdict claims_estimate_divergent, claims_estimate_partial, claims_estimate_unverified or claims_estimate_consistent. POST /api/claims-estimate-check. Reads the claim records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between claim documents only: it never files or submits a claim, never negotiates or pays one and never decides coverage, which stays with the insurer, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Claims reads claim records across the claim lifecycle for consistency between the claim documents and the policy they claim under: a first notice of loss, a sworn proof of loss, an adjuster’s report, a repair or replacement estimate, a settlement offer and release, a denial letter, a subrogation demand and a claim payment record, each against the policy, the first notice, the inspection record and claim file, the approved scope, the claim valuation, the claim record, the payment record or the settlement or adjudication it should agree with. The family is sector-neutral across property, casualty and liability claims and reads different claim documents against each other and against the policy. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-claims-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-claims/.

claim_ref.description: The claim number the estimate cites, such as CLM-2026-0412.

deductible_applied.description: The deductible the estimate takes off.

quantity.description: The quantity, when the line states one.

unit_price.description: The unit price, when the line states one.

net.description: The amount the estimate states after the deductible.

states_over_limit.description: The estimate states that its amount is over the applicable limit.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

deductible.description: The deductible the policy sets, as an amount.

deductible_percent.description: The deductible as a percent of the applicable limit, when the policy sets it that way.

limit.description: The limit that applies to this loss.

number.description: The policy number on the policy.

approved.description: Each item or repair in the approved claim scope.

claim_ref.description: The claim number the approved scope belongs to, such as CLM-2026-0412.

name: wever_claims-estimate-check
title: Claims estimate check
